# Three.js r169

Pinned, locally served ES module from Three.js release r169 (0.169.0), MIT licensed.

- Source: https://github.com/mrdoob/three.js/tree/r169
- Module: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/mrdoob/three.js/r169/build/three.module.min.js
- License: `three.LICENSE.txt`

There are no runtime CDN requests. Used only for the first-person Mamute cabin; the existing Canvas battlefield and shared ballistics remain separate.
